hints.content: The rate of change of the equation is $5$ megabytes per second. To find the number of megabytes Agent Hunt transfers, we can multiply the rate of change by $10$, the transfer time in seconds.
Agent Hunt transfers $50$ megabytes every $10$ seconds.

question.content:
Agent Hunt is transferring classified files from the CIA mainframe to his flash drive.

The variable $S$ models the size of the files on the drive (in megabytes) after $t$ seconds of transfer.

$S=5t+45$

**How many megabytes does Agent Hunt transfer every $10$ seconds?**

[[☃ numeric-input 2]] megabytes
